title: Lifting Finite-Sample Gaussian Approximation of Wide Neural Networks to Functional Convergence
abstract: arXiv:2610.18166v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Randomly initialised neural networks of width $m$ converge to Gaussian processes as $m \to \infty$, with two types of quantitative bounds characterising this convergence. Finite-sample bounds compare the network with its Gaussian limit at a fixed finite sample set, on an arbitrary domain, in the quadratic Wasserstein distance $\mathcal W_2$, achieving a convergence rate of $m^{-1/2}$ with explicit constants. However, these constants grow with the number of samples, so the bound becomes uninformative as the sample set is refined. Functional bounds remove that dependence by comparing the two as random functions, at the price of spherical input, metrics weaker than $\mathcal W_2$, or slower rates. In this paper, we therefore lift a finite-sample bound to a functional one. translated_title: 将宽神经网络的有限样本高斯逼近提升为泛函收敛
translated_abstract: 宽度为 $m$ 的随机初始化神经网络在 $m \to \infty$ 时收敛到高斯过程，有两类定量界刻画了这种收敛。有限样本界在任意定义域上的固定有限样本点集处，以二次 Wasserstein 距离 $\mathcal W_2$ 比较网络与其高斯极限，在显式常数下达到 $m^{-1/2}$ 的收敛速度。然而，这些常数随样本数量增长，因此当样本点集被不断加密时，该界就失去了信息量。泛函界通过将两者作为随机函数进行比较而消除了这种依赖，但代价是要求输入位于球面上、使用弱于 $\mathcal W_2$ 的度量，或收敛速度更慢。因此，本文将一个有限样本界提升为泛函界。该提升过程需要将样本点集不断加密直至其在定义域中稠密，因此必须首先使该界与样本数量无关。我们通过度量……来实现这一点。
tldr: 本文提出将有限样本高斯逼近界提升为泛函收敛界的方法，使宽神经网络向高斯过程的 $\mathcal W_2$ 收敛界摆脱了对样本数量的依赖，从而适用于任意定义域上的稠密样本加密极限情形。
en_tdlr: This paper lifts a finite-sample Gaussian approximation bound for wide neural networks to a functional convergence bound, removing the dependence on the number of samples so that the $\mathcal W_2$ bound holds as the sample set becomes dense in an arbitrary domain.
